item.description: • Messages already on screen, like the device-lost line and sign-in errors, now switch language along with the rest of the app. • The sidebar stays below the window buttons when you change the language while the app is open. • Changing the language no longer sends you back to Home. • Apple Music previews show the right copies when several edits to the same song come in quickly. • Retry after a failed Spotify command runs that command again. • You can reorder tracks in a playlist by dragging them. • Items without a name show their placeholder in German and Spanish too. • Connect Playback is no longer offered for Apple Music. • The bar above Home is empty now instead of saying Spotiglass. • Screenshot mode no longer changes your saved Spotify settings. • Unavailable playlist rows explain why in German and Spanish. • The song info and the headphones button are centred in the player bar. • Keyboard settings work like Raycast's, and the Disconnect Spotify row is gone.
